hunks:
- 'App/**'
      - 'Mobile/**'
      - 'scripts/build-browser.js'
      - 'scripts/browser-compatibility-test.js'
      - 'server/index.js'
      - 'index.html'
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install browser verification dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install playwright==1.57.0
          python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Check map frames and all display sizes
        run: python scripts/map-hardware-browser-test.py --output /tmp/dad-radar-map-check/browser
          cp App/dad-radar-browser.js App/map-roll-browser.js /tmp/dad-radar-map-check/
assert(roll.PROFILE.every(point => point[1] >= 0 && point[1] <= 100), "no vertical overshoot may expose an empty aperture");

<script src="/Mobile/layout.js?v=3"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/Mobile/mobile.css?v=11.5"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/Mobile/layout.css?v=2"><link rel="stylesheet" href="/UI/map-roll-transition.css?v=7" data-dad-radar-map-roll="true">
</head>
